 LAS VEGAS (KSNV) — Open enrollment has begun for people who get health insurance through the Affordable Care Act, as many consumers weigh how rising premiums could affect their budgets.
 Robert Morgen and Brian Douglas of Protect Health , a Las Vegas-based insurance agency, are providing information about the enrollment period and what it could mean for people shopping for coverage.
